generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL TERMS AND CONDITIONS AS PER BID DOCUMENT

technicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer Should Produce the Documents for having experience in Forestry works as Tenderer as Piece Wok Contractor.
Tenderer has to be registered under labour act
The Tenderer has to be registered under G.S.T and Produce the Certificate for having GST Number
The Tenderer should have his own sufficient land or Lease land and water supply for raising seedlings.
Forest Contractors who have Registered their names of forest contracts for the year in any territorial forest division in the year 2026-2027 can participate in this tender.

The Tenderer Should have minimum of Rs. 5,00,000 as bank balance and he should have Capacity to return the loan, for this he has to produce Guarantee Certificate from any of the National or Scheduled bank.
The Tenderer Should Produce copy of Pan Card and Income Tax return filling records as per IT Act 1961

Tenderer should Produce documents like Aadhar Card Telephone (Landline) Bill / Voter ID /Driving License/ Bank Pass book / Ration Card or any other documents issued by competent government authority for residential Proof.

Self-attested document that the contractor/organization is not facing any forest offence case / other criminal cases and has not been a defaulter in forest department /any other department and will not be blacklisted and work is not left unfinished.

Banker DThe details and copies of records of the annual turnover (Bank Pass Book Copy) for the last 3 years, i.e., (2023 24, 2024 25 and 2025 26), must be submitted. The tenderer must have achieved a minimum total annual turnover of Rs. 50.00 lakhs during the last 3 years.etails for reference
